title: How the West can deal with China and Russia

paragraphs: Global power dynamics are shifting as countries look for new ways to manage China’s rising influence and its alliance with Russia. A new proposal suggests dividing geopolitical strategy into three specialized areas.

The first area focuses on sea power and coordinates allies like Japan and Australia to control nine critical ocean choke points used by Chinese ships. The second area focuses on the rimland, crucial zones like the Middle East, where land and sea powers meet, by developing massive trade networks like the India-Middle East Economic Corridor. Meanwhile, countries are building long-term plans to counter Chinese and Russian expansion on land in Eurasia. This new view is reflected in the Pentagon’s decision to rename its regional command back to Pacific Command. This change happened because leaders realized that India’s massive mountain borders effectively isolate it geopolitically and make it far less important to China’s land-based trade plans than Central Asia.

words.d: the way that people or countries behave and react to each other, and changes over time

the outer edge or coastal areas of a huge piece of land, especially around Europe and Asia, where sea and land powers meet

paragraphs: The United States and its allies need a better plan to handle global politics and China’s growth. Experts suggest using three new groups to manage different parts of the world.

One group will work with sea powers like Japan to control important paths in the ocean. Another group will focus on areas like the Middle East, where land and sea powers meet, by building big trade roads to connect countries. At the same time, governments in Europe and Asia are making long-term plans to stop China and Russia from becoming too strong on land.

Finally, the American military recently renamed its Pacific Command. They now see that India’s high mountains separate it from China, so India is actually less important to China’s trade plans than Central Asia.

words.d: a country or a person that helps and supports you because you have the same goals or a special agreement
a track, route, or way which allows you to move from one place to another

paragraphs: Western countries must work together because China and Russia are getting very strong. Leaders want to use three new groups to keep the world safe.

The first group helps sea countries like America and Japan control important water paths in the ocean. The second group helps countries in Asia and the Middle East build big roads for business and trade. Many governments are making long-term plans to stay safe.

Also, the United States changes the name of its army group in the Pacific. They see that India has very big mountains on the border, so China cannot build railways there. This means that India is not part of China’s main plans.

words.d: planned for a long time, not just for a few days
the official line on a map between two countries
